articles.summary: Sounding gives Sails applications one calm testing story: one test() API, one Sails-centered trial context, first-class Inertia and mail testing, and browser flows only when the browser actually matters.
articles.title: Introducing Sounding: A Sails-Native Testing Framework for The Boring JavaScript Stack

articles.summary: I migrated African Engineer from a split testing story built around Playwright, custom Sails bootstrapping, and ad hoc helpers to one Sounding-powered test() API. Here is what changed, and why it reads better.
articles.title: Migrating a Boring Stack Test to Sounding: From Split Tools to One Calm Trial
